name: Asana
description: Asana is a work management platform whose developer documentation describes a REST API with personal access tokens, service accounts and OAuth.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Candidate families were enumerated from the Asana developer documentation pages recorded as sources developers-asana-com-526e7d0a68, -0bccb998c0, -1d3bddfe3f, -7fb4493377, -2b825253f2, -99143697df and -d0ad57efd7, read on 2026-10-04; the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. Asana states its API tokens are opaque and may change format, so no candidate has a researched format.
